title: Recursive NAND input-cost recurrence
statement:
Let $d\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^{2^{d+1}}$. Write $x^{(0)}$ and $x^{(1)}$ for the two consecutive blocks of $2^d$ coordinates of $x$. For each $k$, let $F_k$ be the recursively defined NAND function on $2^k$ signs, where $F_0(y)=y$ and $F_{k+1}(y)$ is $1$ if both block values $F_k(y^{(0)})$ and $F_k(y^{(1)})$ are $-1$, and is $-1$ otherwise; let $C_k(y)$ be the expected number of queries made on input $y$ by the randomized tree at level $k$. Then
\[
C_{d+1}(x)=\frac12\Bigl(C_d(x^{(0)})+\begin{cases}0,&F_d(x^{(0)})=1,\\ C_d(x^{(1)}),&F_d(x^{(0)})\ne1,\end{cases}+C_d(x^{(1)})+\begin{cases}0,&F_d(x^{(1)})=1,\\ C_d(x^{(0)}),&F_d(x^{(1)})\ne1.\end{cases}\Bigr).
\]
